card.title: The Same Ending
card.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First you cancel lunch, then stop calling, then ask for the key.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch. I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what he said before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then? I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too. Public enough that I couldn't beg. Book the corner, please.

mechanism: A treats exhaustion and a rescheduled date as matching steps in an inevitable repetition of abandonment.
confusable: Unlike simple pessimism, A must keep the same feared ending while repurposing each reassuring detail as evidence.
comparison: A restaurant becomes imagined breakup containment, unlike the other alternative's sickbed care and returnable soup container.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
